Fun Facts

  • The Chinese name of this Station alludes to Bride's Pool, a small river in Hong Kong.
  • Sidings Exist at the sides of each track in a manner similar to Pisces Pond Station.
  • The name of this station originates from the fact that a Parkour Track used to exist at where this station currently is. The Parkour tracaks have since been demolished.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YH7saNs5oZU&t=1250s</ref>
  • To correspond to the name of this station, a "Stomachache Queue Jumper" is set up near the Los Sengas Coffee of this station. As a result, this Station is the second station after Peanut Island Station to feature a "Stomachache Queue Jumper".
  • This Station is sister stations with Chosen Surge Station.
